standard_prerequisites.name: Nodes, validity and trees of the SEM forcing
standard_prerequisites.statement: A (sigma, a)-node is an M-finite sequence of pairs of a bit and an M-finite R-transitive subset of X_a, comparable according to the bits; it is valid when each block lies in the corresponding side of the colouring; a (sigma, a)-tree is a set of nodes closed downward under prefixes and it is universal when every non-leaf node can be extended on one of the two sides of any finite partition of a sufficiently long initial segment; the author's own definitions are retained at source lines 819-829 and 853-861.
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes all three objects of the counted lemma, namely the finite universal tree, its leaves and the notion of validity that the leaf must satisfy.

standard_prerequisites.name: The colouring sides A_0(R) and A_1(R) and the scheme Delta^0_2
standard_prerequisites.statement: For the stable colouring R the sets A_0(R) and A_1(R) are the two sides of the partition of the integers induced by R; the scheme Delta^0_2(Y) induction, equivalent to collection for Sigma^0_2, is available in the models of this section.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof proceeds by Delta^0_2 induction along the finite tree and applies universality to the restriction of the two sides to an initial segment, whose M-finiteness is exactly what that scheme provides.

core_obligations: Set up the argument by induction on the finite tree, using the scheme Delta^0_2 (source line 884).
Check the base case: the root of the tree is vacuously valid (source line 885).

Induction step: assume a node of the tree is valid and is not a leaf, and apply universality to obtain a bound r such that on every two-partition of the initial segment of length r there is a side and a block inside that side extending the node inside the tree (source line 886).

Use that the restriction of the two colouring sides to the initial segment of length r is itself an M-finite two-partition, which the scheme provides, so that universality applies to it (source lines 886-888).

Conclude that some side and some block inside that side produce a node of the tree, which by choice of the side is valid, and iterate along the finite tree so that some leaf is valid, which is the statement of the counted lemma (source lines 888-889).

proof_roadmap.step: Start the Delta^0_2 induction and settle the root.
Apply universality to a valid non-leaf to get a bound r and blocks on either side.
Instantiate with the restriction of the colouring sides, obtaining a valid child node.
Iterate along the finite tree to reach a valid leaf.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Lemma lem:sem-wf-valid-leaf（源 880-882 行，证明 883-889 行）：SEM 力迫的任一棵 M-有限泛树都有有效叶。关键操作不是例行核验：作者沿有限树做 Δ⁰₂ 归纳，归纳步要把「泛性」用在一个特殊的二分划——即由稳定着色 R 在长度为 r 的初始段上诱导的两侧 A_0(R)↾r 与 A_1(R)↾r（886-888 行），而这一步之所以合法，正是因为 Δ⁰₂ 归纳（等价于 Σ⁰₂ 收集）保证该限制是 M-有限的；随后由所选侧的定义得知新节点有效，再沿有限树迭代得到有效叶。难点在于「泛性」是 ∞-多量化陈述，必须用对的选择把 M-有限性接上；原文位置在证明的 886-888 行。
